df_weather = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM weather_weekly", con=engine)

df_weekly['item_code'] = df_weekly['crop_full_code'].str.slice(0, 4)

                   .merge(df_weather, on=['year_week', 'station_cd'], how='left')\
                   .merge(df_factor, on=['year_week', 'item_code'], how='left')
